integrity: The only non-elementary prerequisite is the classical fact that generalized Laguerre polynomials with parameter greater than minus one have simple positive roots. Explicit exact-arithmetic checker is included.
scientific_limitations: Only 2<=p<q; canonical Frobenius geometry; uniform vertices, not interior volume; fixed-p asymptotic only; historical priority not independently established.
title: Four strictly ordered inertia modes of rectangular partial-permutation polytopes
